subject: SOC2 addendum request & transition coverage clarification
messages:
From: Julia Park <julia.park@novatrax.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Novatrax Security Team <security@novatrax.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC2 addendum request & transition coverage clarification

Michael —

Hope you’re well. We’re reconciling vendor reports for an upcoming Q1 compliance review and I noticed the SOC 2 Type II report Redwood posted shows an audit period ending 2024-12-31. Our procurement/security team flagged a potential gap for early 2025 because we saw an auditor change on the vendor portal notes.

Can you confirm the following:
- Was there an auditor transition in 2025 and, if so, what are the exact calendar dates that are not covered by the last Type II?
- Do you have an addendum or interim attestation that covers the transition months (we specifically need Jan–Jun 2025 visibility)?
- If controls changed (KMS, retention, or subcontractor scope) during the transition window, please list the changes and point me to any supporting evidence.

We prefer a short PDF attestation we can store with our records. If you already uploaded something to a secure share / Docusign, send the link.

Appreciate a quick confirmation — our deadline to approve vendors for the next procurement cycle is 2026-11-12.

Thanks,
Julia Park
Sr. Vendor Risk Analyst
Novatrax

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@novatrax.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 addendum request & transition coverage clarification

Hi Julia — thanks for the clear note and the deadline heads-up. Short answer: yes, there was a planned auditor transition and we prepared an interim attestation + an addendum covering the window you called out. Attaching the two artifacts here: SOC2_Addendum_2025-interim-attestation.pdf and SOC2_TypeII_2024-summary.pdf.

Key points up front:
- Our last full Type II covers the period ending 2024-12-31.
- The auditor transition occurred in March 2025; during the transition we commissioned an interim attestation that documents control continuity for Jan 1, 2025–Jun 30, 2025. The PDF addendum spells out the scope and the control owner confirmations.
- There were no material changes to encryption (we remained on customer-managed KMS option for Dedicated customers), but we did update our retention matrix for backups (detailed in the addendum).

If you want, Evelyn (security) is copied to confirm the timeline and the backup/retention language. Stephanie is looped for any procurement-level paperwork or signatures you might need. If the Novatrax compliance team needs a signed attestation (DocuSign) we can generate that today.

Best,
Michael Grant
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_Addendum_2025-interim-attestation.pdf (PDF), SOC2_TypeII_2024-summary.pdf (PDF)

Hi Julia — quick technical note from security: the addendum attached to Michael's message includes an audit transition timeline CSV (summary lines below) that our audit team prepared to make the gap explicit.

- 2024-12-31: Last day covered by previous Type II
- 2025-03-10: Engagement with previous auditor concluded
- 2025-03-11 to 2025-04-30: control continuity checks and internal readiness (no external attestation issued)
- 2025-05-01 to 2025-06-30: interim attestation period covered by the addendum (control confirmations by owners)
- 2025-07-01: First full period available under new auditor (reflected in next scheduled Type II)

Controls: no changes to core cryptography or key management for hosted customers; we did tighten backup retention policy for ephemeral test artifacts (not customer data) — details in the addendum.

If you need a signed attestation for your vendor file, say the word and Michael's team can route a DocuSign. I’ve attached the CSV timeline as audit_transition_timeline.csv for your records.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

2) We’ll need a signed PDF (DocuSign ok) for our records. Can you send a link or route the signature flow?
3) Any change to the list of subservice organizations (we need to know if any subcontractors were added or removed between 2024-12-31 and 2025-07-01).

If you can get the signed attestation + a one-line coverage statement to me by end of day (your timezone) 2026-11-06, we’ll be able to keep you off the remediation queue.
